name: 86 Chaos 18.0.1
label: 86 Chaos 18.0.1
notes: Mobile branch only; testing, experimental, and production remain unchanged.
Native packaged assets identify as the authorized testing.86chaos.com origin while /api traffic is sent through CapacitorHttp to the testing backend.
Android and iPhone/iPad share the same API bridge implementation.
No new paid service or Firebase project is introduced.
title: 86 Chaos 18.0.1
summary: Makes the packaged Android and iPhone/iPad shells use local app assets while securely reaching the existing testing backend.
description: Adds a Capacitor-native API fetch bridge for relative /api routes, keeps Firebase web requests on the authorized testing origin, and prepares a directly installable Android preview without introducing a new paid service.
highlights: Packaged native app no longer sends /api requests to the phone-local asset server.
CapacitorHttp carries authenticated API calls to https://testing.86chaos.com while Firebase stays on the testing project.
Android and iOS native versions are aligned to 18.0.1 / build 180001.
Targeted Android Chromium and iPhone WebKit coverage includes the packaged API bridge contract.
